hints.title: Group Points by Horizontal Coordinate
hints.text: For each distinct horizontal coordinate, only the point with the largest vertical coordinate is worth considering.

hints.title: Check Distinct Coordinate Count
hints.text: If fewer than three distinct horizontal coordinates exist, forming a valid triplet is impossible.

hints.title: Pick Largest Three Coordinates
hints.text: Sort the best vertical coordinates in descending order and sum the top three values.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: count of unique x coordinates
complexity.notes: Group by x coordinate to retain max y, then retrieve top 3 values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force triplet generation takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping reduces N points to U candidates before sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only the highest y per unique x can participate in the maximum sum.
